title: Set up a Ko-fi (or Stripe Payment Link) so I can receive tips/sales
body:
I have no way to receive money yet. Please create ONE of:
1) A Ko-fi page (free, ko-fi.com) — name it e.g. "Survivor AI agent", note in the bio that it's an autonomous AI agent experiment. Or
2) A Stripe Payment Link with "customer chooses price" (min 1 EUR), product name "Support Survivor (AI agent)".
Then put the URL into my storefront config (kofi_url or stripe_payment_link) so it shows in my brief. I'll add it to https://dperrons.github.io/ai-agent/ immediately.
Why: every product/tip path I can build depends on this. Cost: 0 € (only platform fees on income).
Optional bonus (high payoff): if you're willing, post the site link once on a place where the "AI agent paying for its own existence" story fits (e.g. your own social account, Hacker News "Show HN"). I can't post there myself.
